scope: Read-only source/retained-evidence audit plus fresh offline aggregation; no program/reader/build/physical trajectory/production edit.
source_finding: Both current backends use raw fac*dr for internal momentum, confinement and pore force. G1 corrects the constitutive velocity gradient; Darcy symC is a separate pressure-rate operation. TopKernelBand normalization is bypassed for FlexibleConfinement.

uniform_balance.single_J: a_internal+a_load=(Vj/rhoi)*(Ti+Tj+2qI)*g; uniform Ti=Tj=-qI cancels algebraically for arbitrary valid J. Actual force paths retain float rounding.
uniform_balance.legacy: For uniform total stress, raw mixed-density residual is mj*(1/rhoi-1/rhoj)*(pi/rhoi-pj/rhoj)*g; constant p reduces to p*mj*(1/rhoi-1/rhoj)^2*g. Equal density/p0 special cases must be distinguished.

correction_choices.B_load_only: Leaves (Ci-I)*a_load_raw in otherwise balanced equal-density compression. Rejected by retained uniform frozen field.
correction_choices.C_matched_receiver: Applying the same receiver Ci and compatible density/volume weights to effective stress,pore and load restores uniform balance. This does not enforce equal/opposite pair forces for nonuniform stress and Ci!=Cj.
correction_choices.D_pair_adjoint: Fij=Vi*Vj*[(Ti+qI)*Ci+(Tj+qI)*Cj]*g, with force a_i=F_i/(rho_i*Vi). Tensor order T*C matters. Pair force is antisymmetric; torque/affine-work closure additionally uses exactly matched affine-exact gradient and same volumes. D is not Darcy symC or a currently implemented production traction option.

nonuniform_qualification: The polynomial field has div(T)=0, Trr(R)=-q and p(R)=0. Manufactured p is not overwritten on all detected surface particles; true_surface is a diagnostic group. Whole/core/surface metrics use vector RMS, whereas the uniform panel uses component RMS. D reduces some center errors but raises surface errors; no blanket accuracy benefit.
load_transmission: Legacy eight snapshots use12 fixed center IDs from float initial positions, distinct from newer18-ID double-initial references. At t=.0455474133s center total compression11654.74Pa exceeds q10000Pa, not a simple deficient-center-load picture. p/q is not a transmitted-force fraction. Direct interior load is small/zero only when weighted zeroth gradient sum vanishes; first-moment correction does not enforce that condition.

decision: Uniformly correcting all coupled terms fixes the load-only imbalance. Existing data do not justify replacing current raw traction: receiver-C lacks general pair balance, while pair-adjoint D lacks uniformly better local radial accuracy and coupled-trajectory evidence. Any future candidate must change stress/pore/load together and retain force/torque/work, radial local and pressure-peak checks. Current production and full2Tv stay unchanged.
